articles.title_zh: 欧盟卡车制造商呼吁推迟CO2排放标准
articles.title_original: EU truck makers call for a delay to CO 2 emission standards
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月14日，在汉诺威IAA交通运输展上，欧洲七家主要卡车和客车制造商（DAF、戴姆勒卡车、福特Otosan、依维柯、曼恩、斯堪尼亚、沃尔沃）的CEO警告，欧洲向零排放重型车转型因配套条件“严重滞后”而受阻，呼吁欧盟及各国政策制定者紧急弥补差距，并将2030年CO2合规时间表推迟三年。目前欧洲新注册重型卡车中仅2.4%为零排放，波兰、西班牙、意大利低于1%，德法分别为4.3%和2.4%。制造商须在2030、2035、2040年分别减排43%、64%、90%，否则面临每克CO2每车4.250欧元罚款；仅2030年目标差三个百分点即约22亿欧元罚款。
articles.content_evidence: news: EU truck makers call for a delay to CO2 emission standards EU truck makers call for a delay to CO 2 emission standards 14 September 2026 At the IAA Transportation in Hanover, the CEOs of Europe’s seven leading truck and bus manufacturers warned that Europe’s shift to zero-emission heavy-duty vehicles is held back by an “alarming delay” in the conditions that are needed to drive market uptake. They called on European and national policymakers to urgently close the gap and to delay the 2030 CO 2 compliance timeline by three years. While European truck and bus manufacturers have launched several zero-emission vehicle models, the conditions that transport operators need to adopt these vehicles at scale and operate them competitively are not developing fast enough, according to the CEOs. articles.title_zh: TEN-T欧洲协调员工作计划发布
articles.title_original: Work plans for TEN-T European Coordinators published
articles.summary_zh: 欧盟委员会交通与运输总司发布新版欧洲交通走廊及横向优先事项工作计划，系修订后TEN-T法规下的首版。计划梳理已取得进展、剩余投资需求，评估基础设施是否符合TEN-T要求，并确定未来最需投资的领域，同时指出须尽快消除的持续瓶颈。欧洲海事空间工作计划聚焦港口、海上连接及其与更广泛欧洲交通网络的融合；欧洲铁路交通管理系统（ERTMS）工作计划已于2月发布，覆盖整个TEN-T铁路网。文件由欧洲协调员、委员会部门、交通部、基础设施管理者及地区和地方利益相关方共同参与编制。发布日期为2026年9月30日。
articles.source_name: 欧盟委员会交通与运输总司
articles.content_evidence: DG MOVE is pleased to announce the publication of the new European Transport Corridor and Horizontal Priorities work plans. Following on from the revised TEN-T Regulation, this first edition of the work plans outlines the progress achieved to date, highlights remaining investment needs, assesses infrastructure compliance with TEN-T requirements, and identifies the investments most needed to implement the Corridors and the horizontal priorities in the years ahead. Each work plan also identifies persistent bottlenecks that must be removed quickly to ensure the Corridors function fully and effectively. The work plan for the European Maritime Space sets out the priorities for strengthening the maritime dimension of the TEN-T, with a particular focus on ports, maritime connections and their integration with the wider European transport network. articles.title_zh: 葡萄牙、斯洛伐克和挪威加入自动驾驶车辆跨境测试床倡议
articles.title_original: Portugal, Slovakia and Norway join cross-border initiative on autonomous vehicle testbeds
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月29日，葡萄牙、斯洛伐克和挪威在布鲁塞尔“连接欧洲日”期间签署《自动驾驶车辆大规模跨境测试床联合意向声明》，西班牙于上周签署，参与国总数增至22个。该倡议依据《欧洲汽车行动计划》启动，旨在汇集成员国、非欧盟国家、地区和地方当局、产业利益相关方及运输运营商，以安全、协调和竞争的方式加速自动驾驶车辆在欧洲的统一商业化预部署。联合声明最初于6月由18个成员国签署。
articles.source_name: 欧盟委员会交通与运输总司
articles.content_evidence: Today, Portugal, Slovakia and Norway signed the Joint Declaration of Intent on large-scale cross-border testbeds for autonomous vehicles during Connecting Europe Days in Brussels. Spain signed the Declaration last week, bringing the total number of participating countries to 22. The additional signatories reflect the continued commitment to accelerate the harmonised deployment of autonomous vehicles across Europe in a safe, coordinated and competitive way, building on the initiative launched under the European Automotive Action Plan. Background The large-scale cross-border testbed initiative for autonomous vehicles was launched under the European Automotive Action Plan. It aims to support the harmonised commercial pre-deployment of autonomous vehicles across Europe by bringing together Member States, non-EU countries, regional and local authorities, industry stakeholders and transport operators. articles.title_zh: 欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩将为2026年欧洲互联日开幕
articles.title_original: President von der Leyen to open Connecting Europe Days 2026
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月28日至10月1日，欧盟委员会旗舰交通与出行活动“欧洲互联日2026”在布鲁塞尔举行，冯德莱恩将于次日14:00 CEST开幕致辞。活动聚焦跨欧洲交通网络（TEN-T）建设、消除瓶颈、提升交通韧性与军事机动性、保障基础设施投资，并讨论海事、港口、高速铁路与客运联通等议题。会议期间将签署希腊、保加利亚和罗马尼亚关键交通链接跨境合作新行动计划。该活动为政策与实施公告，涉及交通基础设施与货运通道，但未明确针对重卡或商用车排放法规。
articles.source_name: 欧盟委员会交通与运输总司
articles.content_evidence: Today marks the start of Connecting Europe Days 2026, the European Commission's flagship event for transport and mobility, taking place from 28 September to 1 October in Brussels. It will bring together leading politicians, industry representatives and the Commission to discuss key transport issues and their role in boosting Europe's competitiveness, connectivity and resilience, including military mobility and defence, across the 27-member bloc and beyond. President of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen will deliver a speech during the opening ceremony tomorrow at 14.00 CEST. You can follow it live on EBS+. Ahead of the opening ceremony, President of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, said: "Transport turns the promise of a connected Europe into an everyday experience. articles.title_zh: 欧盟放宽重型车辆二氧化碳积分规则
articles.title_original: EU eases CO 2 credit rules for heavy-duty vehicles
articles.summary_zh: 2026年3月18日，欧洲议会通过针对重型车辆二氧化碳排放标准（欧盟2019/1242号法规）的定向修订，作为2025年12月汽车一揽子计划的一部分，欧盟理事会已于2026年2月批准。修订允许制造商在2025至2029报告期内，只要二氧化碳排放低于年度排放目标即可获得积分，而原法规要求低于线性减排轨迹才能获得积分，从而增加积分获取灵活性。修订不改变2030年、2035年和2040年分别较2019/2021年减排43%、64%和90%的目标。适用对象为大多数重型卡车。
articles.content_evidence: news: EU eases CO2 credit rules for heavy-duty vehicles EU eases CO 2 credit rules for heavy-duty vehicles 18 March 2026 The European Parliament approved a targeted amendment to the existing CO 2 emission standards for heavy-duty vehicles (Regulation (EU) 2019/1242) to provide manufacturers with more flexibility to ease the compliance with their applicable 2030 CO 2 emission targets. The measure was proposed as part of the Automotive Package released in December 2025. The EU Council already approved the Commission’s proposal in February. The adopted amendments allow manufacturers to collect more emission credits for the 2025–2029 reporting periods than in the original Regulation. While Regulation (EU) 2019/1242 originally allowed manufacturers to receive credits only when their CO 2 emissions were below a linear emissions reduction trajectory, with the adopted amendments they will be able to generate credits as soon as their CO 2 emissions are below their annual emission target.
